key_fields.sql: select z.locationid, z.borough, z.zone, count(t.pulocationid) as cash_trips from ops.zones z left join lake.trips t on t.pulocationid = z.locationid and t.payment_type = 2 group by z.locationid, z.borough, z.zone order by z.locationid
key_fields.claim: The HASH_GROUP_BY processes 99K rows to produce only 265 groups; pre-aggregating trips by PULocationID + payment_type before the join would reduce the join input cardinality by ~400x and eliminate the post-join aggregation.

value.sql:
SELECT z.LocationID, z.Borough, z.Zone, COALESCE(t.cnt, 0) AS cash_trips
FROM ops.zones z
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT PULocationID::BIGINT AS PULocationID, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM lake.trips
    WHERE payment_type = 2
    GROUP BY PULocationID
) t ON t.PULocationID = z.LocationID
ORDER BY z.LocationID
value.change_summary: Pre-aggregate filtered trips by PULocationID before joining to zones, removing the post-join aggregation and reducing join input from ~99K rows to ~243 rows.
value.risk_notes: None; pre-aggregation is semantically equivalent to the original LEFT JOIN + GROUP BY because COUNT(t.PULocationID) counts matching trip rows per zone, which the subquery computes directly.
